classifications.rationale: The President presently determines that the existing tariff level for products of other countries will continue, preserving a legally binding import duty without requiring a later agency decision.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that it is necessary and appropriate, at this time, to maintain the current tariff level

classifications.rationale: The President immediately amends the HTSUS and a prior proclamation to establish duty-free treatment and modified duty rates; subsequent customs administration is ministerial.
classifications.evidence: U.S. Note 16 of subchapter III of chapter 99 of the HTSUS is amended

classifications.rationale: The provision itself imposes a binding 25 percent additional duty on specified steel imports according to stated dates and country exceptions.
classifications.evidence: shall be subject to an additional 25 percent ad valorem rate of duty

classifications.rationale: The provision itself imposes a 50 percent duty on covered Turkish steel imports during the specified period.
classifications.evidence: shall be subject to a 50 percent ad valorem rate of duty

classifications.rationale: The provision itself applies a binding 25 percent duty to covered imports upon the specified triggering date and modifies the HTSUS through the incorporated annexes.
classifications.evidence: shall be subject to the additional 25 percent ad valorem rate of duty established herein

classifications.rationale: The provision itself imposes an additional 10 percent duty on the derivative aluminum imports identified in Annex I.

classifications.rationale: The provision itself imposes an additional 25 percent duty on specified derivative steel imports and fixes the countries and dates to which the prescribed rates apply.
classifications.evidence: shall be subject to an additional 25 percent ad valorem rate of duty

classifications.rationale: The President directly subjects qualifying Ukrainian steel already admitted to a foreign trade zone to a 25 percent duty upon later entry for consumption; customs merely applies that fixed consequence.

classifications.rationale: The provision itself imposes a duty, excludes specified articles from tariff-rate-quota eligibility, and conditions duty-free eligibility on a certificate of origin, all as binding legal consequences.
classifications.evidence: are not eligible for, and shall not count against, the in-quota volume of the tariff-rate quota

classifications.rationale: The President authorizes, but does not compel a specified result from, executive officials implementing the certificate requirement and makes a housekeeping supersession of inconsistent prior directives; possible remedies remain discretionary and governed by existing law.
